title: ConFoo Vancouver 2016 Calling for Papers
content:
We are happy to open the of ConFoo Vancouver 2016! If you are interested in speaking about PHP or other web development topics, please submit until June 6th. We will cover travel and hotel for the speakers who require it.call for papers

ConFoo Vancouver will be held on December 5-7, 2016. For those who are familiar with ConFoo Montreal, that conference will still be running annually in addition to Vancouver. to learn more about the event.Visit our site

Talks are 35 minutes for the topic and 10 minutes for Q&A, for a total of 45 minutes. We are eagerly expecting your proposals!
author: PHP.net news & announcements
